terms.definitionEn: Rendering a collection of items by mapping data to React elements.
terms.definitionAr: عرض مجموعة عناصر عن طريق تحويل كل قيمة في البيانات لـ React element.

terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript array method that returns a new array containing the result of a callback for each item.
terms.definitionAr: method في JavaScript بترجع array جديدة فيها نتيجة callback لكل عنصر.

terms.definitionEn: A special prop that helps React match siblings across renders; it is not passed to the component as an ordinary prop.
terms.definitionAr: prop خاصة بتساعد React يطابق العناصر اللي جنب بعض بين الـ renders، ومش بتوصل للـ component كـ prop عادية.

terms.definitionEn: Choosing which UI to return based on a JavaScript condition.
terms.definitionAr: اختيار واجهة تتعرض حسب شرط مكتوب بـ JavaScript.

terms.definitionEn: A JavaScript expression that chooses one of two values using condition ? valueA : valueB.
terms.definitionAr: تعبير JavaScript بيختار قيمة من اتنين بالشكل condition ? valueA : valueB.

terms.definitionEn: Using condition && element to include an element when the condition is truthy, while remembering that a falsy number such as 0 is rendered as text.
terms.definitionAr: استخدام condition && element عشان العنصر يظهر لما الشرط يبقى truthy، مع الانتباه إن رقم falsy زي 0 ممكن يظهر كنص.

terms.definitionEn: Returning a result before the main JSX path to handle a condition such as loading or missing data.
terms.definitionAr: إنك ترجع نتيجة بدري قبل مسار JSX الأساسي عشان تتعامل مع حالة زي التحميل أو غياب البيانات.

terms.definitionEn: Returning null from a component or rendering null in JSX to produce no UI for that position.
terms.definitionAr: إرجاع null من component أو جوه JSX عشان المكان ده مايعرضش واجهة.

terms.definitionEn: A key derived from an item's stable identity so React can match that item when a list changes.
terms.definitionAr: key طالعة من هوية ثابتة للعنصر عشان React يعرف يطابقه لما القائمة تتغير.

terms.definitionEn: A key made from an item's current array position, which can identify the wrong item after insertion, deletion, or reordering.
terms.definitionAr: key مبنية على مكان العنصر الحالي في الـ array، وممكن تطابق عنصر غلط بعد إضافة أو حذف أو إعادة ترتيب.

terms.definitionEn: The identity React tracks among siblings using element type and key to decide which state belongs to which rendered item.
terms.definitionAr: الهوية اللي React بيتابعها بين العناصر اللي جنب بعض باستخدام نوع العنصر والـ key عشان يحدد الحالة تخص مين.

terms.definitionEn: The possibility that position-based keys attach component state or DOM state to a different item when a list is reordered or edited.
terms.definitionAr: احتمال إن الـ keys المبنية على المكان تربط state أو حالة DOM بعنصر تاني لما القائمة تتغير أو يعاد ترتيبها.

questions.question: What does map produce for this list?
options: A new array containing one React element per name
A single DOM list that React mounts before rendering
A callback that React stores and invokes only on clicks
A copy of names with every string changed into a component
questions.explanation: Array.map returns a new array with one callback result for each name; in React those results describe list items.
questions.explanationAr: Array.map بترجع array جديدة فيها نتيجة لكل اسم، وهنا النتايج بتوصف عناصر القائمة.

questions.question: What is the key used for here?
options: It is automatically available as props.key inside the li component
It helps React match this sibling item between renders
It becomes a visible HTML attribute on the rendered li
It prevents book.title from changing after the first render
questions.explanation: React uses keys to match sibling elements across updates; key is special and is not an ordinary component prop.
questions.explanationAr: React بيستخدم الـ key عشان يطابق العناصر اللي جنب بعض بين التحديثات، ومش بتوصل كـ prop عادية.

questions.question: What does this ternary choose?
options: It always renders Panel, then hides it with CSS if needed
It calls both branches and returns whichever mounts first
Panel for true; otherwise, the button
It converts isOpen into a key for the button element
questions.explanation: The ternary evaluates one branch: Panel for a truthy isOpen value and the button otherwise.
questions.explanationAr: الـ ternary بتقيّم فرع واحد: Panel لو isOpen truthy، والزرار غير كده.

questions.question: When does this expression include Summary?
options: Whenever ready is false, because false means no condition was given
On every render, because JSX ignores the value before &&
Only after Summary has already mounted once in the same component
When ready is truthy, because && then evaluates its right side
questions.explanation: Logical AND evaluates its right operand only when the left operand is truthy, so Summary is included in that case.
questions.explanationAr: && بتقيّم الطرف اليمين بس لما الطرف الشمال يبقى truthy، وساعتها Summary بتظهر.

questions.question: What React-specific display risk does this expression have?
options: An empty array has length 0, which React renders as a number
An empty array is false, so React always renders MessageList here
React treats length as a missing key and skips the full parent
The && operator converts every number to a boolean before rendering
questions.explanation: An empty array has length 0, and the expression evaluates to 0; React renders the number rather than treating it as no output.
questions.explanationAr: لما الـ array تبقى فاضية، length بتساوي 0 والتعبير بيرجع 0؛ React بتعرض الرقم بدل ما تعتبره مفيش حاجة.

questions.question: What does this component return when user is missing?
options: An empty h1 so React can preserve the future user's text
null, which means this component contributes no UI there
The value false, which React converts into a visible label
A fallback Profile element created automatically from the name
questions.explanation: The early return exits the component with null, so React renders no UI at that position.
questions.explanationAr: الـ return المبكر بيطلع من الـ component بـ null، فـ React مش بتعرض واجهة في المكان ده.

questions.question: What role does the first return play?
options: It lets both JSX results render, with the browser selecting one
It delays the section until a second render has completed
It returns the loading paragraph when loading is true
It creates a Hook boundary that resets children state while loading
questions.explanation: When loading is true, the function returns immediately; otherwise it continues to the section JSX.
questions.explanationAr: لو loading true الدالة بترجع فورًا؛ غير كده بتكمل وترجع JSX بتاع section.

questions.question: Why can these keys associate local state with the wrong item after sorting?
options: React resets every child state whenever any array is sorted
Array.map keeps each index attached to the original object forever
React derives keys from item values and ignores the explicit index
After sorting, the same index can belong to a different item
questions.explanation: After reordering, a position key still names that position, so React may preserve the component state for a different data item.
questions.explanationAr: بعد إعادة الترتيب، key المكان بتفضل بتشير لنفس المكان، فممكن React تسيب state مع بيانات عنصر تاني.

questions.question: What does a stable data key communicate to React?
options: It identifies this sibling item across list updates
Which props should be copied into local state on every render
That this row must never be removed from its parent list
Which DOM node must be created even if the row is not rendered
questions.explanation: A stable key lets React match the same logical item when sibling lists are updated.
questions.explanationAr: الـ key الثابتة بتخلي React تطابق نفس العنصر المنطقي لما القائمة تتحدث.

questions.question: What plain value is logged when signedIn is false?
options: Member
Guest
false
null
questions.explanation: The false condition selects the second ternary branch, the string Guest.
questions.explanationAr: لما الشرط يبقى false، الـ ternary بتختار الفرع التاني اللي قيمته Guest.

questions.question: What plain value does the expression produce?
options: Unread
false
an empty string
questions.explanation: Logical AND returns its first falsy operand, which is the number 0.
questions.explanationAr: && بترجع أول قيمة falsy، وهنا القيمة هي الرقم 0.

questions.question: What plain string is logged?
options: Mina, Laila
MINA LAILA
Mina and Laila
MINA, LAILA
questions.explanation: map uppercases each name, and join adds a comma and space between the values.
questions.explanationAr: map بتحول كل اسم لحروف كبيرة، وjoin بتحط فاصلة ومسافة بينهم.

questions.prompt: Insert the property that displays each fruit's name.
questions.explanation: The callback receives one fruit at a time, so fruit.name supplies the text for that list item.
questions.explanationAr: الـ callback بتاخد ثمرة واحدة كل مرة، فـ fruit.name بتدي نص العنصر.

questions.prompt: Use the stable identifier of each task as its key.
questions.explanation: A stable unique task id lets React match a task row when the list changes.
questions.explanationAr: معرّف المهمة الثابت والمميز بيساعد React تطابق صف المهمة لما القائمة تتغير.

questions.prompt: Provide the alternate element for a non-admin user.
questions.explanation: The expression after the colon is the ternary's alternate result when isAdmin is false.
questions.explanationAr: التعبير بعد النقطتين هو النتيجة البديلة لما isAdmin تبقى false.

questions.prompt: Render a count message only when count is positive.
questions.explanation: When count is positive the condition is true, so && evaluates and returns the message element.
questions.explanationAr: لما count تبقى أكبر من صفر الشرط بيبقى true، و&& بترجع عنصر الرسالة.

questions.prompt: Return no UI when user is absent.
questions.explanation: Returning null from a component tells React there is no UI to render for that case.
questions.explanationAr: إرجاع null من الـ component معناه إن مفيش واجهة تتعرض في الحالة دي.

questions.prompt: Pass the current product's title to ProductCard.
questions.explanation: The map callback's product is the current item, and its title property is passed as the title prop.
questions.explanationAr: product هنا هو العنصر الحالي، وخاصية title بتاعته بتتبعت كـ prop.

questions.prompt: Choose the stable schema identifier instead of the current list position.
questions.explanation: A stable identifier such as field.name preserves logical item identity when the list order changes.
questions.explanationAr: معرّف ثابت زي field.name بيحافظ على هوية العنصر لما ترتيب القائمة يتغير.

questions.prompt: Add an early-return element for the empty-results case.
questions.explanation: After the loading case, an early return gives the empty list a distinct UI before the normal results path.
questions.explanationAr: بعد حالة التحميل، return مبكر بيدي القائمة الفاضية واجهة مختلفة قبل مسار النتائج العادي.

questions.question: How do you render a data array as a React list, and what should each callback return?
keyPoints: Use map to transform each data item
Return a React element for each item
Place the key on the top-level element returned for that item
questions.modelAnswer: Use Array.map to transform each data item into a React element, such as an li or a component. Return one element for each item and give its top-level sibling element a stable key.
questions.explanation: Mapping data to elements keeps the UI derived from the collection and gives React identifiable siblings.
questions.explanationAr: تحويل البيانات لعناصر بـ map بيخلي الواجهة طالعة من المجموعة ويدي React عناصر تقدر تميزها.

questions.question: Why are stable keys preferred over array indexes for editable lists?
keyPoints: Keys help React match siblings between renders
Stable data ids keep the same logical item identified
Indexes can shift after insertion, deletion, or reordering
Wrong matching can move component-local state between items
questions.modelAnswer: Keys help React match list siblings across updates, and a stable data id continues to identify the same logical item. An index can point to a different item after an insertion, deletion, or reorder, so state may be preserved for the wrong row.
questions.explanation: A position is not a reliable identity when list membership or order can change.
questions.explanationAr: مكان العنصر مش هوية مضمونة لما عناصر القائمة أو ترتيبها يتغيروا.

questions.question: When would you use a ternary versus logical AND for conditional UI?
keyPoints: Use a ternary when both true and false cases need output
Use && when only the truthy case should add an element
Guard numeric values to avoid rendering 0 accidentally
Both are JavaScript expressions usable in JSX
questions.modelAnswer: Use a ternary when the true and false cases should produce different UI. Use logical AND when the truthy case alone should add an element, but ensure a numeric condition cannot be zero because React renders a zero result as text.
questions.explanation: The two expressions differ in their false-case result, and a falsy number can still become visible React text.
questions.explanationAr: الفرق في نتيجة حالة false، وكمان الرقم 0 ممكن يظهر كنص في React حتى لو هو falsy.

questions.question: How can early returns and null simplify conditional rendering?
keyPoints: Early returns handle exceptional or alternate cases first
The remaining function body can focus on the main UI
Returning null intentionally renders no UI
Conditions should remain clear and preserve Hook rules
questions.modelAnswer: An early return can handle a loading, missing-data, or empty state before the main JSX path. Return null when that branch should display nothing; keep Hook calls at the component's top level rather than placing them after a conditional return.
questions.explanation: Guard clauses separate alternate states from the primary render while null represents intentionally absent UI.
questions.explanationAr: الـ guard clauses بتفصل الحالات البديلة عن الواجهة الأساسية، وnull معناها إن مفيش UI مقصودة.
